raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "PDPbox" %}
{% set version = "0.3.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 86931543e0032803ba38ea4d7486146fa8d715451e40c90ec874b2d2ebb707fe

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python
  script: '{{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv '

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - joblib >=1.1.0
    - matplotlib-base >=3.6.2
    - numpy >=1.21.5
    - pandas >=1.4.4
    - plotly >=5.9.0
    - pqdm >=0.2.0
    - psutil >=5.9.0
    - pytest
    - scikit-learn >=1.0.2
    - setuptools
    - sphinx >=5.0.2
    - sphinx_rtd_theme >=1.1.1
    - tqdm >=4.64.1
    - numpydoc >=1.4.0
    - xgboost >=1.7.1

test:
  imports:
    - pdpbox
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}
  commands:
    - pip check

about:
  home: https://github.com/SauceCat/PDPbox
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: Python partial dependence plot toolbox

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - xhochy
